verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no source-control integration, no environment separation (dev/staging/prod), and no promotion workflow for scenarios. The only related items are 'clone a scenario' and a bare 'scenario history' mention, plus a general REST API and MCP server. Cloning is a manual workaround and the API is a developer building block, so neither counts as the product's own versioning-and-promotion capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
